title: Leaked ci-deployer key used to read the customer exports bucket
summary: The access key of IAM user ci-deployer was pushed to a public repository on 2026-09-12 20:41 UTC. An external address used it 26 minutes later, created a backdoor user and read 1 090 objects (2.31 GB) of customer exports for July and August 2026. The client disabled the key on 2026-09-13 09:41 UTC; the actor made no successful call after that. The database password from the same file is not yet proven rotated.

evidence.claim: 26 minutes passed from the push to the first use of the key
The svc-backup-sync key was never used
2.31 GB was read from 1 090 distinct objects

key_questions.question: How did the attacker get in?
key_questions.answer: A developer pushed a file with a cloud access key to a public code repository. An external address started using the key 26 minutes later.

key_questions.question: Was customer data taken?
key_questions.answer: Yes. 1 090 customer export files from July and August 2026 were downloaded, 2.31 GB in total. Whether other storage was read cannot be determined, because logging was off there.

key_questions.question: Is the attacker still inside?
key_questions.answer: No. The key and the backdoor user were removed on 2026-09-13. Every call after that failed, and no new activity appeared in the following 22 hours.

key_questions.question: Are other secrets at risk?
key_questions.answer: The same file held a database password. We see no proof that it was changed.
